name: review-hard
description: Review the current task changes for correctness, safety, and maintainability risks before slice closure or PR prep, and recommend the smallest safe next step. Use when a slice or task-level implementation was completed, the user wants a focused engineering risk review before closure or PR prep, or meaningful issues need surfacing. Do not use when no meaningful implementation exists yet, the task is in discovery, contract refinement, or planning, or the goal is full external code review replacement. Opt-in --consistency N consensus mode.
